_comment: Specializations and the skills bought with specialization points. Tracks are the five the real game uses. Each skill moves exactly one existing dial -- `effects` are multipliers, `bonuses` are flat adds -- so there is no skill here whose value has to be taken on trust. `trainer` names a wiki POI you must stand at to spend a point in that track; the Hagga Basin South crop only contains three trainer-ish markers, so two tracks share one.

tracks.name: Combat
tracks.desc: Blades, shields, and the things that come out of camps.

tracks.name: Sabotage
tracks.desc: Moving quietly and taking what is left behind.

tracks.name: Exploration
tracks.desc: Reading the basin and surviving the crossing.

tracks.name: Gathering
tracks.desc: Getting more out of every node and every night.

tracks.name: Crafting
tracks.desc: Making it go further at the bench.

skills.name: Shield Drill
skills.desc: A shield you have practised with comes back faster.

skills.name: Trophy Hunter
skills.desc: You learn more from a fight than most.

skills.name: Light Step
skills.desc: The sand carries less of you to whatever is listening.

skills.name: Quick Hands
skills.desc: You draw a body dry in half the time.

skills.name: Night Work
skills.desc: You have learned to work the dark cheaply.

skills.name: Cave Sense
skills.desc: You find the mouth of a cave from further out.

skills.name: Cartographer
skills.desc: Somewhere new is worth more to you than to anyone else.

skills.name: Sun Reader

skills.desc: A vein lasts longer in your hands.
